profile.headline: Lead Java Developer at Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas
profile.summary: An exceptional Technical Professional with more than fifteen years of experience designing and deploying software and web-based solutions for several high value clients. Skilled in project management processes, including requirements gathering, resource allocation, identifying and mitigating potential risks and project scope assessment. Adept in assessing current environments, highlighting under-performing areas, implementing improvements to streamline processes and enhance operational efficiency. Well-versed in guidance and mentoring cross-functional project teams to ensure on time completion of deliverables.
